newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola Femsa cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola Femsa cut.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said it downgraded Coca-Cola FEMSA SA to attractive from its prior rating of buy.
-- In a research report, the brokerage said the downgrade came following a 62 percent price appreciation over the past year and 17 percent in the past thirty days.

-- "We continue to like the company's fundamentals and long-term outlook just as much as we did one year ago. However, the stock's valuation has ... rightfully established itself at the top end of its peer group for the first time," the company said in the report.
-- Shares slipped 1/4 to 30 in early trading.
